Markets rally as central bank holds rates

Markets rally as central bank holds rates

Stocks climbed on Tuesday after the central bank left interest rates unchanged, citing cooling inflation and a resilient labour market. Analysts said the decision was widely expected but the accompanying statement struck a more dovish tone than anticipated.

The index closed up 1.8 percent, its best day in three months. Bond yields fell as traders trimmed bets on further tightening. Technology shares led the gains, with semiconductor makers among the top performers.
